title: Discount Program Share of the Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Phone Payment Fee
content:
**Charges note.** The phone payment fee charged on a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account is multiplied by the program share for the discount program on the financed contract: the military or first-responder program takes the service phone share of 80%; the senior program takes the senior phone share of 90%; no program leaves it whole.

The program is the single discount program recorded at signing on the contract the account finances — the Window Replacement Contracts contract or the Entry & Patio Door Contracts contract it funds. The share multiplies the fee before rounding; only the final fee is rounded to the cent, to the nearest cent with an exact half cent rounding up.

| Discount program on the financed contract | Fee multiplied by |
|---|---|
| Military | 80% |
| First responder | 80% |
| Senior | 90% |
| None | 100% (whole) |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A fee of 12.95 on a contract carrying the military program: 12.95 times 80% is 10.36.
- A fee of 8.45 on a contract carrying the senior program: 7.605, which rounds to 7.61 as a final fee.
- A fee of 8.45 on a contract with no program: 8.45.
